name: myownnotion
description: Single-owner self-hosted knowledge workspace — canonical content foundations

scripts.typecheck: bun run --parallel --filter '*' typecheck && bun run tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test:unit: bun scripts/ci/run-vitest-with-postgres.ts run --project domain --project graph --project page-state --project contracts --project blob-store --project client-core --project web --project workspace-contract
scripts.test:property: bun run --bun vitest run --project domain --project graph --project page-state --project contracts --project blob-store --project client-core property
scripts.test:coverage: bun scripts/ci/run-vitest-with-postgres.ts run --coverage --project domain --project graph --project page-state --project contracts --project blob-store --project client-core --project web --project database-integration --project api-contract --project workspace-contract
scripts.test:e2e: MYOWNNOTION_E2E_BUILD=1 bun run --filter @myownnotion/web build && MYOWNNOTION_E2E_PREBUILT_WEB=1 bun run --bun playwright test --fail-on-flaky-tests
scripts.test:security: bun scripts/ci/run-vitest-with-postgres.ts run --project domain --project contracts --project database-integration --project api-contract --project workspace-contract security
scripts.checks:local: bun run toolchain:check && bun run shell:check && bun run format:check && bun run lint:ci && bun run typecheck && bun run test:coverage && bun run test:performance && bun run test:integration && bun run db:test-migrations && bun run test:contract && bun run test:e2e:gate && bun run build && bun run images:build && bun run security:audit && bun run security:secrets && bun run security:static && bun run security:licenses && bun run compose:check
scripts.build: bun run toolchain:check && bun run --parallel --filter '*' build
scripts.dev: bun run toolchain:check && bun run --parallel --filter '*' dev
